mapper.sql: SELECT s.*, o.name AS organization_name FROM student s LEFT JOIN organization o ON o.id = s.organization_id
mapper.select: WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY s.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student(user_id, name, gender, grade, subject, organization_id, phone, parent_phone, fee, remark) VALUES(#{userId}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{grade}, #{subject}, #{organizationId}, #{phone}, #{parentPhone}, #{fee}, #{remark})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM student WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
